messages:
Riley: Heads-up 10am ask: product wants a lean benchpack for the webinar next Thurs. Need: hero GIF (1200x628), 4 social microcards (1080x1080), an animated 16:9 slide for the keynote, and a one-pager PDF. Can we scope?
Priya: I can scope creative. Two variants: web-native (light) and email-safe (dark). Which metric calls do we highlight?
Tom: Highlight: cost/token delta and 95th pct latency. Also include a small table of test config (model, seq len, GPU type). Keep the table minimal.
Yuki: Design constraints: use brand gradient #0066FF->#00D4FF, type stack: Inter/Source Sans. For the GIF please keep file <500KB. For animated slide, prefer SVG + Lottie export.
Riley: Also need localized copy for EN/DE/FR. Will provide translations by Tue noon.
Priya: Timeline proposal: wireframes by Mon 4pm, first comps Tues noon, GIF & slide Thurs AM for rehearsal. One-pager final Fri.
Tom: Routing note: hero should have two CTAs: [Register] and [Request benchmark]. When clicked, Register -> /events?utm_source=web&utm_campaign=bench_launch, Request benchmark -> gated form (collect company, role, email). Add hidden field: campaign_id=bench_launch_v2.
Yuki: Accessibility check: contrast ratios need to meet 4.5:1 for body text. Microcards should include alt text lines. I'll add alt text examples in figma.
comms-bot: Reminder: Brand policy v3 in drive: https://drive.redwood/brand/policy_v3. Auto-flag will run on final exports.
Priya: Legal + Privacy: avoid naming competitor products. Any benchmarking claims must be prefaced with "Internal Redwood Inference testing" and include test date. Please leave a footer line in the one-pager.
design-lead: I'll take design lead. @Yuki can you do the GIF optimization? @Tom can you draft the copy punchlines and the one-pager data table? @Priya I'll pair on localization slots.
Riley: Thanks. Also, can we get a small hero-safe treatment for embed in email header (600x200) and a mobile-first hero (640x360)?
Yuki: Noted. Will make 3 sizes with center-crop safe zone.
Tom: Uploading a sample CSV of numbers and the suggested axis labels here: drive.redwood/bench/data_sample.csv
Priya: Scheduling a 30min sync Mon 10am to review wireframes. Invite sent.
Riley: Perfect. Please drop Figma links & final export checklist into this thread when ready. :sparkles:
